ai: simulated provider contract tests; not live AI evaluation
checks: Disclosure identifies provider, exact content and retention/cost before any cloud request
Current-trip-only sanitized request returns an unsaved draft; edited explicit save preserves visit identity and draft survives reload
Unclear/conflicting result asks for correction and cannot be saved as an invented memory
Malformed output, rate limits and missing configuration preserve the saved album and require manual retry
Saved card exports a real PNG locally without calling the AI provider
Inclusive date filter affects displayed cards only, validates ranges and leaves map counts unchanged
Replacing a photo set keeps the trip and memory, removes access to old photo copies and adds no visit
Backup download/preview/restore skips identical records, imports conflicts only as new copies and rejects corrupt archives
Mobile AI disclosure fits 390/320px and map feedback respects reduced-motion preference
